# A2A Wire Contract Checklist: A2A relay wire contract (feature 014)

**Purpose**: Unit tests for the requirements writing of feature 014 — do the spec, plan and contracts state the A2A wire behaviour, its idempotency and observation guarantees, and its privacy and retention rules completely, clearly, consistently and measurably? This checklist tests what is written, not the implementation.
**Created**: 2026-09-04
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [plan.md](../plan.md) · [contracts/](../contracts/)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
Use it to verify requirements clarity after `/speckit-plan`; it does not replace
the constitution, ADRs, the `/speckit-review` gate, tests, code review, CI, or
the landing and release gates.

Focus: (1) wire contract, identifiers and observation honesty; (2) privacy, security and retention. Depth: standard. Audience: PR reviewer (ASK review of PR #192) and the acceptance auditor. Items checked `[x]` were confirmed against the artifacts as amended after review campaigns 1 and 2 (`review.md`).

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are the outcomes of a connection test enumerated exhaustively (ready, invalid credentials, unreachable, not an A2A agent, unsupported protocol version, no supported interface, unsupported authentication scheme, private destination, rate limited), each with the error code it sets and the status the connection keeps? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, §SC-009]
- [x] CHK002 Are the identifiers reserved before dispatch (run ID, message ID derived from the reserved run ID that the idempotency key pins, correlation ID used as the protocol conversation identifier) all named with their derivation and lifetime? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006, data-model §2]
- [x] CHK003 Is every state the agent can report mapped to exactly one BrainBuddy projection, including the states that have no natural counterpart (rejected, auth-required, unknown)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009]
- [x] CHK004 Are the preconditions for every content-bearing send (confirmed hand-off, replayed confirmation, Check again, reply) written as an explicit list, and is the rule that no background thread may send content stated as a MUST? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006, §FR-010]
- [x] CHK005 Are requirements defined for the hand-off manifest to disclose the push-notification callback registration when the agent supports push? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005, AC-007]
- [x] CHK006 Are the removal and migration requirements for the bespoke wire specified, including what a pre-existing bespoke record becomes and what happens to its credential? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012, §SC-010]
- [x] CHK007 Are the reference-runtime requirements specific about which runtimes, which of their behaviours must be exercised, and which checks run in CI versus attended? [Completeness, Spec §FR-017]
- [x] CHK008 Are requirements defined for what a queued (not yet sent) hand-off shows and when it becomes Sent? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006, §FR-008, AC-032]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK009 Is "Delivery unconfirmed" defined by the observable condition that produces it (ambiguous or timed-out dispatch) rather than by implementation state, and is the lookup-before-resend rule unambiguous about when a resend is allowed at all? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK010 Is the guarantee tier disclosure quantified in terms of what each tier promises and what residual duplicate risk remains, without implementation vocabulary? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003]
- [x] CHK011 Is "observation interval" bound to a concrete deployment-configured value, and are the backoff bound (at most ten times the interval) and its reset triggers stated as numbers and events rather than adjectives? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008, §SC-006]
- [x] CHK012 Is the reply window quantified (a concrete number of seconds) and is the behaviour at its expiry defined? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007, §FR-010]
- [x] CHK013 Is the difference between "unsupported by this agent", "not cancelable" and "unconfirmed" cancellation outcomes defined by the agent's explicit answer versus an ambiguous failure, so the copy can never claim a capability the agent did not state? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010, AC-029]
- [x] CHK014 Is task succession defined in plain terms (a different task inside the same correlation ID) with the exact timeline text and the rule for the run's single correlation ID? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010, AC-028]
- [x] CHK015 Is the retention of the run identifier distinguished in writing from the retention of agent task identifiers, message identifiers and fingerprints, so the 90-day bound is not overstated? [Clarity, Spec §FR-016, §SC-007, AC-024]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK016 Do the superseded and retained lists in "Relationship to feature 007" agree with every later citation of a 007 requirement in the functional requirements? [Consistency, Spec §Relationship to feature 007]
- [x] CHK017 Do spec.md, plan.md and the API contract state the same rollout-OFF surface (what continues, what is refused, what a Check again may and may not do while OFF)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006, §FR-016, contracts/api-deltas §Rollout OFF]
- [x] CHK018 Do the wire contract, the plan and the research decision agree on when the single-start extension is activated (first send and every replay to a guaranteed-tier agent)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-011, contracts/a2a-wire, contracts/brainbuddy-single-start-extension]
- [x] CHK019 Do the design state inventory and the spec cite the same state ids for task succession, Check again, the Queued variant, inert result links and the rate-limited connection test? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006, §FR-010, design.md]
- [x] CHK020 Do the data model and the API contract use one name for the offered authentication schemes and one shape for the connection-test error detail? [Consistency, data-model §1, contracts/api-deltas]
- [x] CHK021 Are the audit action names for rejected and late push notifications identical across the data model and the push-callback contract? [Consistency, data-model §6, contracts/push-callback]
- [x] CHK022 Does the plan's rollback statement agree with the data model's storage keys (endpoint_url kept, auth header name only for API-key connections, manifest placeholder keys) so a previous image can still parse 014 rows? [Consistency, plan.md §Risks and rollback, data-model §1–§2]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK023 Can every success criterion be verified by a named, deterministic check (a test module, a quickstart scenario or an attended step marked as such), including SC-004 and SC-005? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001–§SC-010, quickstart.md]
- [x] CHK024 Are the three-replays-one-task criterion and the barrier criterion measurable for every submission path, including Check again racing a replayed confirmation and restart recovery? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002, §SC-008, AC-030]
- [x] CHK025 Is the "true terminal state within one observation interval" criterion stated with the interval value and the conditions (pools, saturation) under which it must still hold? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006, §FR-008, AC-034]
- [x] CHK026 Are the log-scan expectations for secrets specific about which logs are captured (application and access logging, verified, rejected and failing pushes) and which strings must be absent? [Measurability, Spec §SC-009, AC-024]
- [x] CHK027 Does every acceptance scenario name the user-observable outcome (label, copy, control state) rather than an internal transition? [Measurability, Spec §User Scenarios & Testing]

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK028 Are alternate flows specified for an agent that ignores the client-supplied conversation identifier (no automatic resend, disclosure text)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-006, §FR-003]
- [x] CHK029 Are exception flows specified for a dispatch that times out, a reply that meets a task the agent already failed on its own timeout, and a cancel request that fails ambiguously? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, AC-028, AC-029]
- [x] CHK030 Are recovery flows specified for a process restart during a queued exchange, an open start exchange and an open reply exchange, each with a distinct outcome? [Coverage, Spec §FR-006, §FR-010, AC-032]
- [x] CHK031 Are the multi-tenant scenarios (one owner's slow agents, a drip-feeding agent, pool saturation, cancel behind held workers) covered by requirements with observable bounds? [Coverage, Spec §FR-008, AC-034, AC-035]
- [x] CHK032 Are rollout-OFF scenarios for existing runs (observation, verified push, reply, cancel, lookup-only Check again) covered? [Coverage, Spec §FR-016, AC-036]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK033 Is the behaviour for an agent task record that exceeds the response cap defined so the run reaches its true terminal state with a visible "too large to store" marker instead of Stopped reporting? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-016]
- [x] CHK034 Are the boundaries of the suspension of predecessor observation during a reply defined (exit at exchange close, interruption or deadline) so no run can wait forever? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-010, AC-033]
- [x] CHK035 Is the behaviour of a late but valid push notification after the run's terminal observation defined and distinguished from a forged token? [Edge Case, contracts/push-callback, data-model §7]
- [x] CHK036 Is the behaviour of an observation that arrives after the run's content tier has expired defined so no agent text is re-persisted? [Edge Case, data-model §2, §8]
- [x] CHK037 Is the behaviour of a restart-before-send hand-off defined so a run that provably never left BrainBuddy is never shown as Delivery unconfirmed? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-006, AC-032]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [x] CHK038 Are consent boundaries written for every egress of task content, including the resend branches and the reauthentication window they inherit from 007? [Security, Spec §FR-004, §FR-006, AC-030]
- [x] CHK039 Are the push-token handling rules complete — stored only as a keyed fingerprint, never in responses, audit rows, timeline events or any BrainBuddy log line, with the residual platform-edge risk named? [Security, Spec §FR-016, §SC-009, contracts/push-callback §Redaction]
- [x] CHK040 Are untrusted-text rendering rules specified for every agent-sourced string, including card fields and connection-test error detail, on both web and iOS? [Security, Spec §FR-016, AC-031]
- [x] CHK041 Are retention tiers (30-day content, 90-day identifiers and audit, connection-lifetime card summary) each tied to a named sweep or erasure event and to the read-time projection? [Privacy, Spec §FR-016, §SC-007, data-model §8]
- [x] CHK042 Is the purge disposition of the agent-side copy of the callback address stated, with the user-facing notice that covers it? [Privacy, contracts/push-callback §Deregistration]
- [x] CHK043 Are the accessibility requirements for the new controls (Check again, Copy link, acknowledgement, disabled states on mobile) and the focus-containment rules for dialogs and sheets specified? [Accessibility, design.md §Keyboard and focus]
- [x] CHK044 Are the bounded-resource requirements (absolute request deadline, per-connection exchange bound, separate pools, bounded limiter keys) stated with their defaults? [Performance, Spec §FR-008, data-model §9]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK045 Is the assumption that no production bespoke connection records exist stated together with the pre-deploy count that validates it and the migration audit that records what was rewritten? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions, plan.md §Risks and rollback]
- [x] CHK046 Are the Hermes A2A plugin behaviours the design depends on (blocking send up to 300 s, in-memory tasks, terminal-only push, no message-id deduplication, orphan timeout) documented as verified facts with their sources? [Dependency, research.md F1–F12]
- [x] CHK047 Is the iOS client distribution model stated accurately (store profile exists) and is the release gate that follows from it recorded as the Principle III migration note? [Dependency, contracts/api-deltas §Compatibility]
- [x] CHK048 Is the public availability of the extension identifier's repository path a stated dependency with a named check? [Dependency, Spec §FR-011, plan.md §6]
